title: GenotypingPriorityEntry
description: Single gene × population × organ priority score for pre-transplant genotyping.

gene_symbol.description: HGNC gene symbol (e.g. CYP3A5, TPMT, NUDT15)

population_code.description: 1000 Genomes super/sub-population code, excluding CEU baseline

population_affected_pct.description: Percentage of the cohort requiring dose or therapy adjustment

delta_vs_baseline.description: Deviation in percentage points from CEU baseline population_affected_pct

waitlist_patients.description: Total patients on waitlist for this organ (most recent year, all covered countries)
